########################
# Load libraries and data

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(data.table)
library(readxl)
library(igraph)
library(stringr)
library(ReactomePA)
library(biomaRt)

# Set seed
set.seed(69)

# Load Seurat object and update
load("path/to/seurat/object/Analysis_1_object_post_UMAP_res_1_260319_v3_DIET_recoloured_alex.Robj") %>%
  UpdateSeuratObject()

# Load cluster annotation key
annotation_key <- read.csv("path/to/annotation/key/ClusterAnnotations_Ryan.csv")

# Load all human_mouse ortholgos
all_genes <- read.csv("path/to/gene/map/All_HumanMouseGenes.csv", row.names = 1)

# Load full list of Reactome terms, and their relationships
reactome_pathways_all <- fread("path/to/reactomedb/files/ReactomePathways.txt", header = F)
reactome_pathways_hierarchy <- fread("path/to/reactomedb/files/ReactomePathwaysRelation.txt", header = F)

# Load CellPhoneDB results
pvals <- read.delim("path/to/cellphonedb/outputs/statistical_analysis_pvalues_05_16_2025_174230.txt", check.names = F)
means <- read.delim("path/to/cellphonedb/outputs/statistical_analysis_significant_means_05_16_2025_174230.txt", check.names = F)
decon <- read.delim("path/to/cellphonedb/outputs/statistical_analysis_deconvoluted_05_16_2025_174230.txt", check.names = F)
pcent <- read.delim("path/to/cellphonedb/outputs/statistical_analysis_deconvoluted_percents_05_16_2025_174230.txt", check.names = F)
score <- read.delim("path/to/cellphonedb/outputs/statistical_analysis_interaction_scores_05_16_2025_174230.txt", check.names = F)
```

########################
# Pre-process the data
########################

```{r}
# Convert cluster IDs to names - Seurat object meta data
diet_regions.combined.final1.v3$seurat_clusters <- factor(x = annotation_key$cluster_name[match(diet_regions.combined.final1.v3$res.1, annotation_key$cluster_number)],
                                                          levels = annotation_key$cluster_name)

# Set Idents
Idents(diet_regions.combined.final1.v3) <- "seurat_clusters"
```

########################
# Prepare ReactomeDB hierarchy for analysis
########################

```{r}
# Filter ReactomeDB databases for mouse terms
reactome_pathways_all <- reactome_pathways_all %>%
  setNames(c("ID", "Name", "Species")) %>%
  filter(str_detect(Species, "Mus musculus"))

reactome_pathways_hierarchy <- reactome_pathways_hierarchy %>%
  setNames(c("Parent", "Child")) %>%
  filter(str_detect(Parent, "^R-MMU-"), str_detect(Child, "^R-MMU-"))

# Combine tables
reactome_pathways_hierarchy <- reactome_pathways_hierarchy %>%
  mutate(Parent_ID = Parent, Child_ID = Child) %>%
  left_join(reactome_pathways_all %>% dplyr::select(ID, Name), by = c("Parent_ID" = "ID"), suffix = c("", "_parent")) %>%
  left_join(reactome_pathways_all %>% dplyr::select(ID, Name), by = c("Child_ID" = "ID"), suffix = c("", "_child")) %>%
  dplyr::select(Parent_ID, Name, Child_ID, Name_child) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Parent_Name = Name, Child_Name = Name_child)

# Calculate term levels
all_terms <- unique(c(reactome_pathways_hierarchy$Parent_ID, reactome_pathways_hierarchy$Child_ID))
top_level_terms <- setdiff(unique(reactome_pathways_hierarchy$Parent_ID), unique(reactome_pathways_hierarchy$Child_ID))

levels_df <- data.frame(Term = all_terms, Level = NA_integer_)
levels_df$Level[levels_df$Term %in% top_level_terms] <- 1

repeat {
  n_before <- sum(!is.na(levels_df$Level))

  # For all edges where parent level is known and child level is unknown, assign child level = parent level + 1
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(reactome_pathways_hierarchy))) {
    parent <- reactome_pathways_hierarchy$Parent_ID[i]
    child <- reactome_pathways_hierarchy$Child_ID[i]
  
    parent_level <- levels_df$Level[levels_df$Term == parent]
    child_level <- levels_df$Level[levels_df$Term == child]
  
    if (!is.na(parent_level) && is.na(child_level)) {levels_df$Level[levels_df$Term == child] <- parent_level + 1}
  }

  n_after <- sum(!is.na(levels_df$Level))
  
  # Stop when no new levels are assigned
  if (n_before == n_after) break
}

# Merge with original dataframe
reactome_pathways_hierarchy <- reactome_pathways_hierarchy %>%
  left_join(levels_df %>% dplyr::rename(Parent_Level = Level), by = c("Parent_ID" = "Term")) %>%
  left_join(levels_df %>% dplyr::rename(Child_Level = Level), by = c("Child_ID" = "Term"))

# Calculate directed acyclic graph (DAG) detailing the relationships between terms
edges <- reactome_pathways_hierarchy %>% dplyr::select(Parent_ID, Child_ID) %>% distinct()
g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = TRUE)
roots <- V(g)[degree(g, mode = "in") == 0]$name
ordered_terms <- c()
for (r in roots) {
  dfs_result <- dfs(g, root = r, order = TRUE, unreachable = FALSE)
  ordered_terms <- c(ordered_terms, V(g)[dfs_result$order]$name)
}
ordered_terms <- ordered_terms[!is.na(ordered_terms)]

# Named vector: ID -> Name
id_to_name <- reactome_pathways_hierarchy %>%
  dplyr::select(ID = Parent_ID, Name = Parent_Name) %>%
  bind_rows(reactome_pathways_hierarchy %>% dplyr::select(ID = Child_ID, Name = Child_Name)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  deframe()
```

########################
# Generate summary data
########################

```{r}
# Generate mapping of mouse to human genes
gene_mapping <- data.frame(mgi_symbol = rownames(diet_regions.combined.final1.v3)) %>%
  left_join(all_genes, by = "mgi_symbol") %>%
  filter(!is.na(HGNC.symbol)) %>%
  distinct(HGNC.symbol, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
# Build named vector for HGNC -> MGI mapping
hgnc_to_mgi <- gene_mapping %>%
  filter(HGNC.symbol != "", mgi_symbol != "") %>%
  distinct(HGNC.symbol, mgi_symbol) %>%
  deframe()

# Write function to extract complex genes
get_complex_genes <- function(partner_col, decon) {
  complex_names <- str_remove(partner_col, "^complex:")
  sapply(complex_names, function(x) {
    if (is.na(x) || x == "") return("")
    paste(unique(decon %>% filter(complex_name == x) %>% pull(gene)), collapse = "; ")
  })
}

# Write function to convert HGNC gene strings to MGI
convert_complex_to_mgi <- function(hgnc_string, mapping_vector) {
  if (hgnc_string == "") return("")
  genes <- unlist(strsplit(hgnc_string, ";\\s*"))
  mgi_symbols <- mapping_vector[genes]
  mgi_symbols[is.na(mgi_symbols)] <- genes[is.na(mgi_symbols)]
  paste(mgi_symbols, collapse = "; ")
}

# Generate summary table
results_summary <- means %>%
  # Process means table
  pivot_longer(cols = 15:ncol(.), names_to = "variable", values_to = "mean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean)) %>%
  separate(variable, into = c("cell_type_a", "cell_type_b"), sep = "\\|", remove = FALSE) %>%
  # Add gene mapping for partners
  left_join(gene_mapping %>% filter(HGNC.symbol != "") %>%
              dplyr::select(HGNC.symbol, ensembl_gene_id, mgi_symbol) %>%
              dplyr::rename(gene_a = HGNC.symbol, ensembl_gene_a = ensembl_gene_id, mgi_symbol_a = mgi_symbol),
            by = "gene_a") %>%
  left_join(gene_mapping %>% filter(HGNC.symbol != "") %>%
              dplyr::select(HGNC.symbol, ensembl_gene_id, mgi_symbol) %>%
              dplyr::rename(gene_b = HGNC.symbol, ensembl_gene_b = ensembl_gene_id, mgi_symbol_b = mgi_symbol),
            by = "gene_b") %>%
  # Add p-values and scores
  left_join(pvals %>%
              pivot_longer(cols = 14:ncol(.), names_to = "variable", values_to = "pval") %>%
              filter(pval <= 0.05) %>%
              separate(variable, into = c("cell_type_a", "cell_type_b"), sep = "\\|", remove = FALSE) %>%
              dplyr::select(id_cp_interaction, variable, pval),
            by = c("id_cp_interaction", "variable")) %>%
  left_join(score %>%
              pivot_longer(cols = 14:ncol(.), names_to = "variable", values_to = "score") %>%
              filter(score > 0) %>%
              separate(variable, into = c("cell_type_a", "cell_type_b"), sep = "\\|", remove = FALSE) %>%
              dplyr::select(id_cp_interaction, variable, score),
            by = c("id_cp_interaction", "variable")) %>%
  # Replace NA mapping columns with empty string
  mutate(across(c(ensembl_gene_a, mgi_symbol_a, ensembl_gene_b, mgi_symbol_b), ~ ifelse(is.na(.), "", .))) %>%
  relocate(ensembl_gene_a, mgi_symbol_a, ensembl_gene_b, mgi_symbol_b, .before = everything()) %>%
  # Add columns showing genes for complexes
  mutate(complex_genes_a       = get_complex_genes(partner_a, decon),
         complex_genes_b       = get_complex_genes(partner_b, decon),
         complex_mgi_symbols_a = sapply(complex_genes_a, convert_complex_to_mgi, mapping_vector = hgnc_to_mgi),
         complex_mgi_symbols_b = sapply(complex_genes_b, convert_complex_to_mgi, mapping_vector = hgnc_to_mgi)) %>%
  # Convert to factor
  mutate(cell_type_a = factor(cell_type_a, levels = annotation_key$cluster_name), cell_type_b = factor(cell_type_b, levels = annotation_key$cluster_name)) %>%
  # Re-order table
  arrange(cell_type_a, cell_type_b, desc(score), pval, desc(mean)) %>%
  dplyr::select(variable, interacting_pair, id_cp_interaction,
                cell_type_a, partner_a, receptor_a, gene_a, complex_genes_a, ensembl_gene_a, mgi_symbol_a, complex_mgi_symbols_a,
                cell_type_b, partner_b, receptor_b, gene_b, complex_genes_b, ensembl_gene_b, mgi_symbol_b, complex_mgi_symbols_b,
                annotation_strategy, secreted, is_integrin, directionality, classification, rank, pval, mean, score)

# Save results table
write.csv(results_summary, file = "CellPhoneDB_InteractionsTable.csv")
```

########################
# Perform pathway enrichment analyses for interaction pairs between osteoblasts and selected clusters
########################

```{r}
# Create ensembl objects for human and mouse genes
ensembl_mus <- useEnsembl(biomart = "ensembl", dataset = "mmusculus_gene_ensembl", host = "https://dec2021.archive.ensembl.org")
ensembl_hum <- useEnsembl(biomart = "ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl", host = "https://dec2021.archive.ensembl.org")

# Generate mapping table to convert to and from Entrez IDs
LDS_mouse <- getLDS(attributes = "mgi_symbol", filters = "mgi_symbol", values = row.names(diet_regions.combined.final1.v3), mart = ensembl_mus,
                    attributesL = c("entrezgene_id", "ensembl_gene_id"), martL = ensembl_mus, uniqueRows = T)
LDS_human <- getLDS(attributes = "mgi_symbol", filters = "mgi_symbol", values = row.names(diet_regions.combined.final1.v3), mart = ensembl_mus,
                    attributesL = c("hgnc_symbol", "entrezgene_id", "ensembl_gene_id"), martL = ensembl_hum, uniqueRows = T)
gene_mapping_2 <- left_join(LDS_mouse, LDS_human, by = "MGI.symbol")
colnames(gene_mapping_2) <- c("MGI_Symbol", "EntrezID_Mouse", "Ensembl_Mouse", "HGNC_Symbol", "EntrezID_Human", "Ensembl_Human")

# Write function to convert Entrez IDs in tables to MGI symbols
convert_gene_ids <- function(gene_list, map) {
  m <- setNames(map$MGI_Symbol, as.character(map$EntrezID_Mouse))
  sapply(gene_list, function(x) {paste(na.omit(m[unlist(strsplit(x,"/"))]), collapse = "/")})
}

# Write function to calculate Jaccard similarity
jaccard <- function(a, b) length(intersect(a, b)) / length(union(a, b))

# Write function to add root term to each row
get_root_name <- function(term_id, g, id_to_name) {
  if (!(term_id %in% V(g)$name)) return(NA)
  ancestors <- subcomponent(g, term_id, mode = "in")
  if (length(ancestors) == 0) return(id_to_name[[term_id]])
  ancestor_ids <- names(ancestors)
  in_degrees <- degree(g, v = ancestor_ids, mode = "in")
  root_candidates <- ancestor_ids[in_degrees == 0]
  if (length(root_candidates) == 0) return(NA)
  root_id <- root_candidates[1]
  id_to_name[[root_id]]
}

# Specify clusters of interest
cells.to.plot <- c("31. Endothelial cells", "32. Vascular SMCs", "27. Chondrocytes", "30. Osteoclasts")

# Generate visualisations for each cluster
cluster_interactions <- lapply(X = cells.to.plot, FUN = function(cluster){

  ##########   Process data   ##########
  
  # Subset interactions for cell types of interest, excluding self-signalling
  interactions <- results_summary %>%
    filter(cell_type_a %in% c("28. Osteoblasts", cluster), cell_type_b %in% c("28. Osteoblasts", cluster), cell_type_a != cell_type_b)
  
  # Extract list of genes involved in interactions between clusters
  int_genes <- c(interactions$mgi_symbol_a, interactions$mgi_symbol_b, strsplit(interactions$complex_mgi_symbols_a, "; "), strsplit(interactions$complex_mgi_symbols_b, "; ")) %>%
    unlist() %>%
    unique()
  
  # Convert genelists to Entrez IDs
  int_genes_entrez <- gene_mapping_2 %>%
    filter(MGI_Symbol %in% int_genes) %>%
    pull(EntrezID_Mouse)
  
  gene_universe <- gene_mapping_2 %>%
    filter(MGI_Symbol %in% row.names(diet_regions.combined.final1.v3)) %>%
    pull(EntrezID_Mouse) %>%
    as.character()
  
  # Identify enriched KEGG pathways amongst genes involved in interactions
  reactome_results <- enrichPathway(gene = int_genes_entrez, organism = "mouse", pAdjustMethod = "bonferroni", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.05, universe = gene_universe)

  # Process results table
  reactome_results@result <- reactome_results@result %>%
    # Convert gene IDs back to MGI, p values to log10(p values) and add term levels
    mutate(MGI_Symbol   = convert_gene_ids(geneID, gene_mapping_2),
           p.adjust.log = -log10(p.adjust),
           Level        = if_else(ID %in% top_level_terms, 1, reactome_pathways_hierarchy$Child_Level[match(ID, reactome_pathways_hierarchy$Child_ID)])) %>%
    # Add indentation to show hierarchy breakdown
    mutate(order_index = match(ID, ordered_terms), Hierarchical_Name = paste0(strrep("  ", Level - min(Level, na.rm = TRUE)), ID)) %>%
    # Add root term to table
    mutate(Root = sapply(ID, get_root_name, g = g, id_to_name = id_to_name)) %>%
    # Re-order to match hierarchy
    arrange(order_index)
  
  return(reactome_results)
})
names(cluster_interactions) <- cells.to.plot

# Combine Reactome results into single dataframe for comparison
reactome_combined <- imap_dfr(cluster_interactions, function(cluster_data, cluster_name) {cluster_data@result %>% mutate(Cluster = cluster_name, .before = 1)})

# Identify unique terms
unique_reactome_terms <- imap_dfr(cluster_interactions, ~ .x@result %>% mutate(Cluster = .y, .before = 1)) %>% filter(!ID %in% ID[duplicated(ID)])

# Collapse redundant terms
cluster_interactions_collapsed <- lapply(X = cells.to.plot, FUN = function(cluster){

  ##########   Set up naming and plotting parameters   ##########
  
  # Extract Reactome results
  results <- cluster_interactions[[cluster]]@result
  
  ##########   Process data   ##########
  
  # Process results table
  gene_sets <- results %>%
    dplyr::select(Description, geneID) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate(GeneList = strsplit(geneID, "/")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Description, GeneList) %>%
    deframe()
  term_ids <- names(gene_sets)
  
  # Calculate Jaccard similarity between terms to identify those with highly overlapping gene lists
  jaccard_matrix <- outer(term_ids, term_ids, Vectorize(function(i, j) jaccard(gene_sets[[i]], gene_sets[[j]])))
  dimnames(jaccard_matrix) <- list(term_ids, term_ids) # Plot as heatmap to view similar terms
  
  # Identify highly similar pairs
  adjacency <- (jaccard_matrix >= 0.8)
  diag(adjacency) <- FALSE
  
  jac_graph <- graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adjacency, mode = "undirected")
  clusters <- components(jac_graph)$membership
  
  term_to_cluster <- tibble(ID = names(clusters), ClusterGroup = clusters) %>%
    bind_rows(tibble(ID = setdiff(results$ID, names(clusters)), ClusterGroup = max(clusters) + seq_len(length(setdiff(results$ID, names(clusters))))))

  # Prepare ReactomeDB hierarchy information
  hier_graph <- graph_from_data_frame(reactome_pathways_hierarchy[, c("Parent_ID", "Child_ID")], directed = TRUE)
  id_to_level <- reactome_combined %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, Level) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    deframe()
  
  # Identify level 2 ancestor for each term
  get_level2_ancestor <- function(term_id) {
    if (!term_id %in% V(hier_graph)$name) return(NA)
    anc <- names(subcomponent(hier_graph, term_id, mode = "in"))
    lvl2 <- anc[id_to_level[anc] == 2]
    if (length(lvl2)) lvl2[1] else NA
  }

  level2_map <- tibble(ID = reactome_combined$ID) %>%
    mutate(Level2_ID = map_chr(ID, get_level2_ancestor))
  
  # Process results to remove redundant terms
  results_clustered <- results %>%
    # Combine data tables
    left_join(term_to_cluster, by = c("Description" = "ID")) %>%
    # Collapse terms into Level 3, ensuring fair representation when multiple level 2 terms have high Jaccard similarity
    left_join(level2_map, by = "ID") %>%
    group_by(ClusterGroup, Level2_ID) %>%
    arrange(abs(Level - 3), Level != 3, p.adjust, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    # Annotate unique terms (i.e. terms specific to cluster of interest) and proportion of genes present for each term
    mutate(Unique = ID %in% unique_reactome_terms$ID[unique_reactome_terms$Cluster == cluster], GenesIncluded = paste0(sub("/.*","", GeneRatio), "/", sub("/.*","", BgRatio))) %>%
    # Re-order
    arrange(Root, p.adjust.log)
  
  return(results_clustered)
})
names(cluster_interactions_collapsed) <- cells.to.plot

# Save Reactome and KEGG enrichment results
save(cluster_interactions, file = "PathwayEnrichmentResults.rds")
save(cluster_interactions_collapsed, file = "PathwayEnrichmentResults_Collapsed.rds")
```
